entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure used by a UE to attach for EPS services, emergency bearer services, or access to RLOS. Different attach types are indicated for different service scenarios.

entities.name: EPS attach type
entities.description: Information element that indicates the type of attach procedure being initiated by the UE.

entities.name: Normal service attach
entities.description: Condition where UE initiates attach procedure for normal EPS services.

entities.name: Emergency bearer services attach
entities.description: Condition where UE initiates attach procedure for emergency bearer services.

entities.name: RLOS access attach
entities.description: Condition where UE in limited service state initiates attach procedure for access to RLOS.

entities.name: EPS attach indication
entities.description: Property that UE shall indicate EPS attach type in the EPS attach type IE when initiating attach procedure.

relations.description: Attach procedure includes the EPS attach type information element.
When UE initiates attach for normal service, it establishes the requirement to indicate EPS attach in the EPS attach type IE.
When UE initiates attach for emergency bearer services, it establishes the requirement to indicate EPS emergency attach in the EPS attach type IE.
When UE initiates attach for RLOS access, it establishes the requirement to indicate EPS RLOS attach in the EPS attach type IE.
